# The Missing Piece

> Browser-based TikTok LIVE interactive word games and 12 free daily solo word, crossword, and visual puzzles built for creators, livestream hosts, and word game players at https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun.

## Overview

The Missing Piece (`https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun`) is a free web gaming platform offering two main collections:
1. **TikTok Interactive Games (9 Games)** — Real-time audience-driven word and drawing games with transparent browser-source `/overlay` URLs for TikTok LIVE Studio and OBS Studio, direct TikTok LIVE chat parsing, TikFinity & BetterTok webhook support, and a built-in test simulator.
2. **Solo Word & Puzzle Games (12 Games)** — Free browser-playable daily and endless word, crossword, rebus, word search, and visual puzzles featuring unified Google / Email & Password authentication with Firebase multi-session cloud progress sync, daily streaks, and public leaderboards.

## Supported Word Game Languages (7 Dictionaries)

Crowdle, Word Hunt Extreme, Squared, DeStack, MP Search, Lexi Tiles, and InkStream support live switching between 7 dictionaries:
- English (`en`), Spanish (`es`), French (`fr`), German (`de`), Italian (`it`), Portuguese (`pt`), and Filipino / Tagalog (`tl`).

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/): Platform overview and featured TikTok interactive & daily word game collections.
- [TikTok Interactive Games](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games): Directory of all 9 creator livestream word & chat games with 3 free daily rounds per game or unlimited Stream Key access.
- [Solo Games Hub](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games): Directory of all 12 solo word, crossword, and puzzle games with Firebase cloud progress sync and public leaderboards.
- [All Interactive Overlays](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/overlays): Combined transparent live overlay directory for TikTok LIVE Studio and OBS Studio.

## TikTok Interactive LIVE Games (9 Games)

- [Word Hunt Extreme](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/mpwh): Alphabetical A–Z word ladder game across Classic (1 word), Dual Ladder (2 words), and Quad Hunt (4 boards) with 4-second TikTok LIVE stream-lag winner buffer, bisect/letter clue hints, and 7 languages.
- [Crowdle](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/crowdle): Crowd-voted Wordle battle for TikTok LIVE chat featuring Decision Sync timers, Endless Chain mode, First-to-Find bonuses, and 7 languages.
- [InkStream](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/inkstream): Live drawing and TikTok LIVE chat word-guessing game (also supporting up to 20-player rooms) with private streamer word picker, TikFinity & BetterTok webhooks, and artwork gallery.
- [Squared Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/squared): Real-time 4×4 word grid hunt where TikTok chat players claim 4+ letter words and trigger `!rotate` and `!hint`.
- [Lexi Tiles Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/lexi): Fast-paced live anagram tile arena for TikTok LIVE chat audiences across 7 languages.
- [DeStack Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/destack): Chat-driven 4-layer 3D 5-letter word unstacking pyramid with auto-reveal timers.
- [MP Search Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/mpsearch): Blind 10×10 TikTok LIVE word search with Places 1–5 podiums and 7 languages.
- [WiKirecTangled Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/wikirec): Viewer-driven 8-connected 3D keycap Wikipedia word discovery with transparent overlay.
- [WikiContexto Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/wikicon): Live TikTok chat redacted Wikipedia article decryption using semantic closeness rankings.

## Solo Word, Crossword & Puzzle Games (12 Games)

- [MP Colossal — 200×200 Giant Crossword Atlas](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpcolossal): 40,000-square pan-and-zoom crossword atlas with 25 themed quest sectors, 4,100+ clues, Atlas Radar minimap, 3-tier hints, and 12×12 Stream Layout.
- [Cruciverbalist Daily Crossword](https://cruci.missingpiecepuzzles.fun/): Daily 20×20 and 8×8 thematic crosswords mixing standard and cryptic clues.
- [Missing Rebus](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/rebus): Archive of 733+ visual wordplay rebus challenges, 53 printable worksheet grids, and timed sprint mode.
- [Squared — Daily Word Grid](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/squared): Daily swipeable letter grid across 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 boards with 90° board rotation and 7 languages.
- [Thematix — Word Association](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/thematix): Daily alphabetical theme-linked word association puzzles with custom puzzle builder.
- [DeStack — Word Unstacking](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/destack): 3D layered letter-tower unstacking puzzles across Standard (4-layer) and Hard (6-layer) modes in 7 languages.
- [Unolingo — 26-Letter Crossword](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/unolingo): Zero-clue 10×10 deduction crossword using every letter A–Z once, with a 183-day archive.
- [WiKirecTangled (Solo)](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/wikirec): Trace 8-connected paths across a 3D keycap board to uncover hidden Wikipedia article titles.
- [WikiContexto (Solo)](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/wikicon): Redacted Wikipedia article discovery using semantic closeness rankings.
- [MP Search — Daily Word Search](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpsearch): Tactile 10×10 letterpress word search puzzles with a 368-day archive in 7 languages.
- [MP Difference — Spot the Difference](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpdifference): Side-by-side illustrated visual spot-the-difference game with a 2.2× optical loupe across 8 worlds.
- [TEKSCOdle — UK Supermarket Price Guesser](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/tekscodle): Price 1-item, 3-item, and 5-item UK supermarket baskets in Daily Basket, Endless Practice, and Quick Play modes.
